unit_name: LXVI Corps (LXVI Reserve Corps until 5 August 1944)
source_locator: R411: p. 45; R244: table of 1944, September row
current_activity: Lucht's LXVI Corps holds the north flank of Army Group G in the Neufchâteau-Langres sector
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 1 p. 45: "the independent LXVI Corps (General der Artillerie Walther Lucht), operating on the north flank of the army group in the Neufchâteau-Langres sector"; Lexikon der Wehrmacht, LXVI Korps, table 1944: September, 19. Armee, Heeresgruppe G, "Vogesen". Event definition: the situation in the first days of September (CMH dates the army group description to 5 September); the Lexikon table is month-level. Event support: CMH and the Lexikon (two families); the Lexikon puts the corps under the Nineteenth Army, CMH has it directly under Army Group G. Location: Neufchâteau (Vosges) with a precision of 25 km, the name given for the sector. Location approximate: a sector point; no corps headquarters place is given. Location support: CMH names the sector. Commander: General der Artillerie Walther Lucht. Opponents: US XII Corps.
